microtheory.name: prefrontal_executive
microtheory.definition: Prefrontal cortex as executive control + working memory + metacognition. The last region to fully myelinate (~25 yrs). Three main subdivisions: dorsolateral (working memory, goal maintenance); ventromedial (value + emotion regulation); orbitofrontal (outcome representation, flexibility). The substrate's analog is its meta-cognitive layer: ArchitectureCortex assesses subjects; DevelopmentCortex orchestrates self-improvement; the derivation_mechanism walks theory + reports gaps.

concepts.name: dorsolateral_prefrontal_cortex
concepts.definition: DLPFC. Working memory maintenance + manipulation; rule application; cognitive control; planning. Lesion → perseveration, impaired Wisconsin Card Sort. Goldman-Rakic 1995. Substrate analogue: the substrate's ArchitectureCortex holding assessment in working state.

concepts.name: ventromedial_prefrontal_cortex
concepts.definition: VMPFC. Value computation; emotional regulation; somatic marker (Damasio). Lesion → poor decisions despite intact intellect. Substrate analogue: substrate's value-of-outcome reasoning across the drive ensemble.

concepts.name: orbitofrontal_cortex
concepts.definition: OFC. Reward valuation; reversal learning; representing identity of outcomes; flexible behaviour under contingency change. Substrate analogue: substrate's flexibility in reassigning ActionSpec coverage when contingencies shift.

concepts.name: anterior_cingulate_cortex
concepts.definition: ACC. Conflict monitoring; error detection; effort allocation; motivation. Activates when goals conflict or errors occur. Substrate analogue: the substrate's coherence drive surfacing rule conflicts + the derivation_mechanism's gap detection.

concepts.name: frontopolar_cortex
concepts.definition: FPC, area 10. Largest in humans relative to brain size. Meta-cognition; multitasking; prospective memory. Holds future-pending intentions. Substrate analogue: long-horizon planning + the substrate's deferred-task tracking.

concepts.name: working_memory_neuron
concepts.definition: DLPFC neurons fire sustainedly during delay periods, holding info active for upcoming use. Goldman-Rakic + Funahashi 1989 — delay-period activity is the neural substrate of working memory. Substrate analogue: σ states sustained across substrate's tick cycles.

concepts.name: persistent_activity
concepts.definition: The recurrent-loop attractor underlying working memory. Network state that, once entered, can maintain itself in absence of input. Substrate analogue: a Mt's persistent basin even after the input that produced it is gone.

concepts.name: cognitive_control
concepts.definition: Top-down modulation of perception, attention, action by goals. Implemented by PFC projections to sensory + motor + striatal areas. Substrate analogue: deliberate goal-driven biasing of ArchitectureCortex assessment.

concepts.name: inhibitory_control
concepts.definition: Suppression of inappropriate responses. Right inferior frontal gyrus + ACC. Lesion produces disinhibition (Phineas Gage). Substrate analogue: ActionSpec blockade via the indirect-pathway analog.

concepts.name: task_switching
concepts.definition: Reconfiguring which rule applies between trials. PFC + ACC. Switch cost reveals limits of cognitive flexibility. Substrate analogue: switching active ArchitecturalQuality scoring contexts.

concepts.name: metacognition
concepts.definition: Knowing what you know. Confidence judgments, knowledge-of-knowing, error monitoring. Anterior PFC. Fleming + Lau 2014. Substrate analogue: the derivation_mechanism reporting which Mts are dormant — substrate-level knowledge of its own enactment gaps.

concepts.name: error_detection
concepts.definition: ACC + medial PFC detect committed errors WITHIN ~100ms — the error-related negativity (ERN) ERP signature. Substrate analogue: gap reports + UndeclaredEnactmentEvent.

concepts.name: conflict_monitoring
concepts.definition: Botvinick 2001. ACC tracks how much two responses compete; signals PFC to recruit more cognitive control on subsequent trials. Substrate analogue: detect_dormant_theory + drive_coherence_between_layers.

concepts.name: prospective_memory
concepts.definition: Remembering to do something in the future. Frontopolar cortex. Substrate analogue: scheduled handlers in the substrate's reflex loop.

concepts.name: effort_computation
concepts.definition: ACC computes cost-benefit of effortful action. Whether to invest in working memory, attention, response selection. Substrate analogue: drive_parsimony weighing concept cost vs information gain.

concepts.name: theory_of_mind
concepts.definition: Representing others' mental states. Medial PFC + temporoparietal junction. Substrate analogue: in a multi-agent substrate, modelling other agents' Mt states.

concepts.name: self_referential_processing
concepts.definition: Medial PFC selectively engaged for thinking about oneself. Substrate analogue: substrate's introspection over its own state — derivation_mechanism applied to self.

concepts.name: social_evaluation
concepts.definition: OFC + VMPFC compute social value (popularity, reputation). Substrate analogue: in collaborative substrate, valuing inputs from other substrate instances.

concepts.name: delay_discounting
concepts.definition: Preference for immediate over delayed rewards. PFC integrity correlates inversely with discounting steepness. Substrate analogue: substrate's parameter for how much it weighs current vs deferred ΔF.

concepts.name: model_based_reasoning
concepts.definition: Reasoning about consequences via internal world model. PFC + hippocampus. Slow, flexible. Contrasts with model-free habit. Substrate analogue: substrate's curiosity-drive what-if probes — explicit forward simulation.

concepts.name: executive_attention
concepts.definition: Top-down attention controlled by goals + working memory. PFC + parietal + thalamic pulvinar. Substrate analogue: drive-priority biasing the substrate's reflex selection.

concepts.name: frontal_lobe_syndrome
concepts.definition: Pattern after PFC damage: perseveration (Wisconsin Card Sort), disinhibition, planning impairment, theory-of-mind deficits, lack of awareness of deficits (anosognosia). The 'classic frontal patient' from neurology. Substrate analogue: what failure-mode looks like when meta-cognition fails — substrate that can't introspect or adjust to feedback.

concepts.name: myelination_completes_late
concepts.definition: PFC continues myelinating until ~25 years old. Adolescent risk-taking partly reflects immature prefrontal control over limbic drives. Substrate analogue: the substrate's developmental loop — late-arriving regulatory layers.

rules.name: pfc_maintains_goals_via_persistent_activity
rules.head: the substrate has a goal it must hold across multiple tick cycles
rules.body: the prefrontal analog maintains the goal via persistent activity — a sustained Mt-state independent of momentary input. Substrate's ArchitectureCortex assessment subject is held this way across the assess loop.

rules.name: acc_monitors_conflict
rules.head: two responses compete simultaneously
rules.body: the anterior cingulate analog signals conflict; the substrate recruits more cognitive control (more rigorous derivation_mechanism passes). Substrate's coherence-drive surfaces conflict the same way.

rules.name: metacognition_reports_knowledge_state
rules.head: the substrate is asked what it knows
rules.body: the prefrontal analog computes confidence + gaps; reports both. Substrate's TheoryEnactmentGap reports are this metacognitive output.

rules.name: inhibitory_control_suppresses_inappropriate
rules.head: an ActionSpec would fire but contradicts an active goal
rules.body: the prefrontal-via-basal-ganglia analog suppresses it via the indirect pathway. Substrate's policy_filter implements this gating.

rules.name: effort_allocation_via_cost_benefit
rules.head: an investigation is possible but costly
rules.body: ACC computes expected information gain vs cost. The substrate's drive_parsimony + drive_curiosity arbitrate this trade-off the same way.

rules.name: model_based_planning_uses_simulation
rules.head: the substrate considers consequences of a possible action
rules.body: the PFC-hippocampal loop simulates the future state. Substrate's curiosity-drive what-if probes implement this — explicit forward simulation rather than habit.
